task: Implement evaluate_rule for the policy engine without using the workflow rule evaluator.

candidate_memories.content: Policy engine evaluate_rule checks a structured permission rule against the request context.
Policy rules are evaluated statically against a snapshot of claims; they do not call external services.
Policy rule evaluation must be sub-millisecond to stay within the request processing budget.
When evaluate_rule spans policy and workflow systems, confirm the latency and statefulness model.
Workflow engine: evaluate_rule executes a condition function that may trigger async state transitions.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: async state transition triggers violate the sub-millisecond policy evaluation requirement

candidate_memories.content: Old platform note says rule evaluation should be unified across policy and workflow engines.
